title: Dana Point Sportfishing

services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Southern California is shaping up for some excellent summer fishing, and the action out of Dana Point continues to improve. With warm water pushing in and clean conditions offshore, anglers have plenty of opportunities whether you’re fishing locally, the islands, or offshore. Yellowtail Yellowtail remain the headline species this week. Schools are showing on local kelp paddies and around the islands, with fish ranging from 10 to over 25 pounds. Live sardines have been getting the majority of the bites, while surface irons and Colt Snipers have been producing quality fish when they’re up feeding. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Dana Point Sportfishing provides the ultimate whale watching trips, giving you an up close and personal experience with the wildlife we have just outside Dana Point Harbor. Southern California has some of the richest sea life in the world. There is no better way to experience it than on a private boat with just your family and friends. We offer trips for up to 6 passengers on our Parker Boat (LOA 30′). Our private boats provide a unique atmosphere where you’ll have the chance to see Whales, Dolphins, Sharks, Marlin, Seals, Sun Fish and variety of other sea life.
